purpose: When a peer's invariant SPINE record count exceeds the context cap, rank and select by relevance to the current query instead of flat file order, so a specifically-referenced anchor (e.g. a named Axiom) is reliably surfaced rather than silently excluded by position.

capabilities.name: label_match_promotion
capabilities.function: Detect an explicit numbered/named anchor reference in the query and guarantee that record's inclusion regardless of cap position.

capabilities.name: invariant_relevance_ranking
capabilities.function: Rank remaining invariant records by relevance to the query for the remaining cap budget, instead of flat file order.

capabilities.name: cap_overflow_disclosure
capabilities.function: Report which invariant records were included versus excluded when the total exceeds the cap, instead of a silent slice.

evidence.source: Tracey-directed: Gabe live Axiom 11 retrieval failure, root-caused to advocate.py's flat invariant-record cap
